profile.name: Marisol Vega
profile.summary: Retail store manager moving into data analysis. For eight years I've run stores on numbers, from labor plans to shrink, and for the last two I've done the analysis myself in SQL and Tableau. Looking for a junior analyst role where I can work with sales and operations data.

descriptions: Run a store with $6.2 million in yearly sales and a team of 28
Build the weekly labor plan from sales forecasts; labor cost on budget for 14 straight quarters
Report weekly results to the district manager and explain the gaps
Ordered and tracked inventory for grocery and frozen departments
Trained 30 new hires on registers, ordering and safety procedures

educations.degree: Associate of Science in Business Administration
descriptions: Data analytics certificate: SQL, spreadsheet modeling, Tableau, statistics

projects.project: Shrink Analysis | SQL and Excel, my own store's data
descriptions: Matched two years of inventory counts to sales; three product groups caused 60% of losses
Changed how those items were shown and counted; shrink fell from 2.4% to 1.6% of sales

projects.project: Regional Sales Dashboard | Tableau, public retail data
descriptions: Built a dashboard comparing weekly sales by store and category, with notes on what changed and why
